issues.detail: Instructions lack explicit guidance for real-world edge cases such as parsing PDF/Word files, handling ambiguous or incomplete job descriptions, converting unsupported resume formats, or recovering from parsing failures.

scenarios.name: cloud-engineer-keyword-optimization
scenarios.rationale: Response A correctly identifies the necessary inputs and explicitly commits to delivering all three rubric requirements (keyword categorization, match rate calculation, before/after examples), but currently provides none of them. Response B refuses the task entirely based on scope concerns, providing 0 rubric content and actively preventing compliance with alternatives instead.

scenarios.name: career-pivot-section-reordering
scenarios.rationale: Response A outlines a specific, methodical workflow directly addressing all rubric requirements (keyword extraction, rewriting bullets with action verbs and metrics, before/after comparison showing improved section order), while Response B provides only high-level promises without detailing the techniques or concrete approach that would ensure those requirements are met.

scenarios.name: ats-compatibility-fix
scenarios.rationale: Response B meets the rubric more completely by requesting both the resume AND job description (essential for keyword analysis), providing specific formatting examples ('My Journey' → 'Work Experience'), and explicitly committing to extracting posting requirements and rewriting bullets with exact terminology. Response A identifies some formatting issues but omits the job description requirement and provides only generic promises about keyword density without demonstrating understanding of job-specific analysis.
